civilopediaText.text: The clan's own spring (元泉), where the yearly awakening is held. The deeper a youth walks into the spring's pressure, the better the grade; a clan without its spring awakens blind.

name: Gu Academy
uniques: New [Military] units start with [10] XP [in this city]

civilopediaText.text: The clan school (学堂). Every new student picks a first Gu from its Gu room, and those who stay cultivate there between battles.
Mortal servants grow and gather the foods the clan's Gu eat. Unglamorous, and the reason the clan's Gu are still alive.
A village tavern (酒肆) selling wine to mortals and Gu Masters alike. It also feeds the Liquor Worm and hears every rumour.

A sealed, quiet room stocked with materials and spare stones, where a Gu Master can pour essence into a recipe undisturbed. Careful refinement happens here, at a price; reckless refinement happens anywhere.

The stockade wall (寨墙) of a mountain village, manned by Gu Masters and elders when beasts or rivals come. Every Qing Mao village trusts its wall; a formation, if the clan ever learns one, is raised behind it.

name: Martial Arena
uniques: New [Military] units start with [20] XP [in this city]

civilopediaText.text: The Wu clan's battle stage (演武场), the largest in the Southern Border. Its Gu Masters fight each other until they no longer lose to anyone else.
A shop (商铺) where caravans trade Gu, materials and stones. Everything here has a price, including information.
The hidden inheritance of a demonic Gu Master who died on Qing Mao (花酒行者传承). Its heir gains jade, insight and strength, and inherits a grudge: its last prize ruins the heir's own spring.

name: Shang Clan City
uniques: Receive [+50]% Gold from Barbarian encampments and pillaging Cities

civilopediaText.text: The Southern Border's great market city (商家城), where even demonic loot changes hands. The Shang clan does not ask where the goods came from.
Defences planned before the calamity comes (one per clan). It opens the cheapest way through earthly calamities and, with essence, through heavenly tribulations.
Stores laid in for the calamity (one per clan): after an earthly calamity the land is rebuilt from the vault for 40 stones.
